issues.title: El Niño drove drought, but climate change intensified Indonesia’s fire crisis: Study
issues.title_en: El Niño drove drought, but climate change intensified Indonesia’s fire crisis: Study
issues.summary: Human-caused climate change significantly amplified extreme heat during Indonesia’s 2026 fire season, turning an El Niño-driven drought into a severe regional crisis, according to a recent rapid analysis. The report was released by World Weather Attribution (WWA), a global network of researchers who analyze the influence of climate change in extreme weather events. The researchers […]
